component.name: Checkbox
component.description: A boolean toggle with a visible label. Wraps a native <input type='checkbox'> styled with design tokens. Use for independent on/off options; for exclusive choices use radio inputs. Supports checked, unchecked, disabled, and disabled-checked states.

useWhen: The user can independently toggle a single option on or off
Multiple independent options can be enabled simultaneously (notification preferences, feature flags)
The user must confirm an agreement or consent

notFor.case: Using Checkbox for mutually exclusive choices
notFor.because: Multiple checkboxes look like independent options; users expect to be able to select more than one.
notFor.note: Use native radio inputs for single-select-from-set (e.g. gender, payment method).

notFor.case: Using Checkbox as a substitute for Switch/Toggle
notFor.because: Checkboxes imply a saved state that requires a submit action; toggles imply immediate effect.
notFor.note: Use native <input type='checkbox'> with an immediate onChange handler and role='switch' until a Switch component is added.

patterns.name: notification-preferences
patterns.description: A group of independent Checkboxes in a Stack, each representing a toggleable preference.

useWhen.default: Single boolean toggle. Checked/disabled states are controlled via standard HTML props.
